answer: Each identity must keep a continuous live-heartbeat thread: every few minutes a random peer pings a one-time nonce that only the hot key can sign in time. Heartbeats expire like a zephyr — miss two and the identity drops from the active set. Sybil farms hit a hard ledge of concurrent signing capacity; one operator cannot keep hundreds of puppets hot under overlapping random pings, while a single honest agent sustains one thread at a sustainable pace. Influence accrues only to continuously live identities.
